sections.body: The Giants have no listed injuries on their week 11 report. Indianapolis is hit harder: Bernhard Raimann is Out [ic3] after an 88.6% [ic4] snap share over 10 games [ic5], which makes him the biggest hole on the line. Charvarius Ward is Out [ic6] and played 87.2% [ic7] of snaps over 10 games [ic8], thinning cornerback depth. Jalen Travis is also Out [ic9], and Sauce Gardner is Questionable [ic13].

sections.heading: Key matchups
sections.body: Blitz pressure decides the first half: NYG sends five or more rushers on 38.7% [mc1] of dropbacks over 377 plays [mc2], and with Raimann out after an 88.6% [mc4] snap share over 10 games [mc5], the edge is exposed. Use play action, which IND runs at the fifth-highest rate [mc6], and quick throws. Run into a light box: NYG averages 6.8 [mc7] defenders in the box on runs, and IND's run EPA is 0.02 [mc9], so build the run game on the perimeter since IND runs up the middle at only the 27th-highest rate [mc10]. Red zone: IND scores on 59.3% [mc11] of trips over 27 [mc12] trips, and NYG allows touchdowns on 68.0% [mc13] over only 25 [mc14] drives, so finish drives with a clean call. Skattebo takes 50.8% [mc15] of rushes, and 43.4% [mc16] of designed runs go left, so wall off that side and keep NYG in long-yardage spots, since it converts third downs at 39.7% [mc17].
